title: The Gravity of the Rust Belt Anew
author: Astrid Thornbury
blurb: Ansel Brightwater, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
